name: Quick Part Import
description: Drag & drop part ZIPs from Component Search Engine, SnapEDA, UltraLibrarian or Octopart into a library that lives inside your project
description_full:
Adds a drop window to the schematic and PCB editor. Drop the ZIP you downloaded from Component Search Engine (SamacSys), SnapEDA, UltraLibrarian or Octopart and the part lands in one library inside the project folder (lib/<Project>.kicad_sym, .pretty and .3dshapes), registered in the project's library tables with ${KIPRJMOD} paths.

Symbols are linked to their footprints and footprints to their 3D models. Importing a part again updates it without duplicates, a failed import never changes anything, and an optional watcher imports part ZIPs as soon as they land in your Downloads folder.

Needs the KiCad API: Preferences > Plugins > Enable KiCad API.
